  inputs = {
      'input_word_ids': input_word_ids.to_tensor(),
      'input_mask': input_mask,
      'input_type_ids': input_type_ids}

def bert_encode(hypotheses, premises, tokenizer, max_len=50):

  num_examples = len(hypotheses)

  sentence1 = tf.ragged.constant([
      encode_sentence(s)
      for s in np.array(hypotheses)])
  sentence2 = tf.ragged.constant([
      encode_sentence(s)
       for s in np.array(premises)])

  cls = [tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(['[CLS]'])]*sentence1.shape[0]
  input_word_ids = tf.concat([cls, sentence1, sentence2], axis=-1)

  input_mask = tf.ones_like(input_word_ids).to_tensor(shape=[num_examples, max_len], default_value=0)

  type_cls = tf.zeros_like(cls)
  type_s1 = tf.zeros_like(sentence1)
  type_s2 = tf.ones_like(sentence2)
  input_type_ids = tf.concat(
      [type_cls, type_s1, type_s2], axis=-1).to_tensor(shape=[num_examples, max_len], default_value=0)

  inputs = {
      'input_word_ids': input_word_ids.to_tensor(shape=[num_examples, max_len], default_value=0),
      'input_mask': input_mask,
      'input_type_ids': input_type_ids}

  return inputs
